changes.text: 僵局之中，以西事自任的左宗棠上奏，逐条点出哪几处不可许，主张「先之以議論，委婉而用機，次決之以戰陣，堅忍而求勝」。奏上获嘉许，崇厚得罪去，朝廷命曾纪泽使俄改约；他于是自请出屯哈密。六年四月（原文年号纪年），他「輿櫬發肅州」，五月抵哈密。七月，他奉诏入都备顾问，由西路统兵的锦棠（原文仅作此称，与东路统兵的金顺并非一人）接替。明年正月，和议成，交还伊犁。

Into that deadlock stepped Zuo Zongtang, who had taken the western affairs upon himself, with a memorial. Item by item he named the terms that must not be accepted, and argued that one should "first take the matter up in negotiation, tactful and alert to opportunity, then settle it on the field of battle, patient and set on victory." The throne commended it; Chong Hou was punished and dismissed, and the court sent Zeng Jize to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo then asked leave to move his headquarters to Hami. In the fourth month of the sixth year (by the reign-year count used in the source) he "set out from Suzhou with a coffin in his carriage," and reached Hami in the fifth month. In the seventh month he was summoned to the capital and Jintang (as the source calls him; a different man from Jin Shun, who led the eastern column), who led the western column, took his place. In the first month of the following year, peace was concluded and Ili was returned.

dispositions.rationale: 在 hook.1 中锦棠首次出现处加注说明：原文仅作此称，且与东路统兵的金顺并非一人。中英文同步修改。这里不断言“锦棠”是名还是其他称呼，也不补外部姓氏。两人在原文中分属西路、东路，故可判定并非同一人。story.6 和 story.8 已统一沿用“锦棠”和 Jintang，无需改动。

evidence.quote: 錦棠經布魯特游牧為西路
